Name: Guardian
Description: The Tank archetype: draw the enemy's eye and shrug off what lands.

Nodes.Name: Shield Wall
Nodes.Description: Learn to bash a foe off balance and open its guard.

Nodes.Name: Iron Will
Nodes.Description: Shake off venom before it takes hold.

Nodes.Name: Sacred Challenge
Nodes.Description: Force every nearby foe's eye onto you.

Nodes.Name: Judgment of Warding
Nodes.Description: A warded strike that punishes anything that dares test your line.

Nodes.Name: Hands of Mercy
Nodes.Description: A tank's own patch job, no cleric required.

Nodes.Name: War Stomp
Nodes.Description: A ground-shaking stomp that staggers everything close.

Nodes.Name: Unstoppable Momentum
Nodes.Description: Charge in a straight line, shrugging off anything in the way.

Nodes.Name: Overrun
Nodes.Description: Flatten a whole line with sheer mass.

Nodes.Name: Battle Cry
Nodes.Description: Steel the whole party's resolve.

Nodes.Name: Rally Point
Nodes.Description: Plant a banner the party rallies around.

Nodes.Name: Marked for the Warband
Nodes.Description: Mark a foe every ally's blade is drawn to.

Nodes.Name: Mana Siphon
Nodes.Description: Drain a foe's focus and choke off its next spell.

Nodes.Name: Venomous Grip
Nodes.Description: A venom-laced grip that keeps gnawing after you let go.

Nodes.Name: Dark Communion
Nodes.Description: Feed on the fight's violence to mend your own wounds.

Nodes.Name: Last Bastion
Nodes.Description: Anything that lands a blow on you pays for it.

Name: Warrior
Description: The Striker archetype: close the distance and keep swinging.

Nodes.Name: Cleaving Strikes
Nodes.Description: A wide swing that catches more than one foe.

Nodes.Name: Battle Fury
Nodes.Description: A war cry that hardens the whole line.

Nodes.Name: Wild Swing
Nodes.Description: An all-out swing thrown with zero guard.

Nodes.Name: Skull Rattle
Nodes.Description: A haymaker that rattles a foe's senses.

Nodes.Name: Last Man Swinging
Nodes.Description: The lower your own HP, the harder this lands.

Nodes.Name: Probing Thrust
Nodes.Description: A quick thrust that reads a foe's guard.

Nodes.Name: Guard Stance
Nodes.Description: A stance that turns the next landed hit into an opening.

Nodes.Name: Decisive Cut
Nodes.Description: The cut that ends it, once the opening is read.

Nodes.Name: Fade Step
Nodes.Description: Slip half-out of the fight for a heartbeat.

Nodes.Name: Smoke Veil
Nodes.Description: A veil of smoke that covers a repositioning strike.

Nodes.Name: Vanishing Cut
Nodes.Description: Strike, then simply aren't there anymore.

Nodes.Name: Undying Rampage
Nodes.Description: Every landed blow heals for half the damage it deals.

Name: Ranger
Description: The Ranged archetype: never needs to be adjacent to strike.

Nodes.Name: Focused Aim
Nodes.Description: A called shot that picks the deadliest opening.

Nodes.Name: Covering Fire
Nodes.Description: Pin down a whole line or column from range.

Nodes.Name: Deadeye Shot
Nodes.Description: A patient, perfectly placed shot.

Nodes.Name: Piercing Volley
Nodes.Description: A shot that punches clean through a whole column.

Nodes.Name: Execution Shot
Nodes.Description: A called shot held one beat too long for anything but the kill.

Nodes.Name: Binding Shot
Nodes.Description: A weighted bolt that fouls a foe's footing.

Nodes.Name: Pitfall Volley
Nodes.Description: A spread of snares across a square of ground.

Nodes.Name: Snare Net
Nodes.Description: A net that stops feet and voice alike.

Nodes.Name: Covering Volley
Nodes.Description: Fire down a column to keep a whole lane honest.

Nodes.Name: Retreat Shot
Nodes.Description: A shot loosed while falling back.

Nodes.Name: Rapid Barrage
Nodes.Description: A full quiver loosed down the line in one breath.

Nodes.Name: Hunter's Resilience
Nodes.Description: Field-worn leathers turn physical blows aside - they land at 70%.

Name: Mage
Description: The Mage archetype: ranged elemental AoE damage.

Nodes.Name: Arcane Bolt
Nodes.Description: A fast, reliable bolt of raw mana.

Nodes.Name: Chilling Frost
Nodes.Description: Ice that locks a square of the field in place.

Nodes.Name: Quickstrike
Nodes.Description: A blade quickened by a sliver of spent mana.

Nodes.Name: Overchannel
Nodes.Description: Push a spell past safe limits for a harder hit.

Nodes.Name: Followthrough
Nodes.Description: A blade strike that carries a spell's momentum into the next.

Nodes.Name: Trapline
Nodes.Description: Lay a line of arcane snares ahead of the advance.

Nodes.Name: Ward Grid
Nodes.Description: A grid of wards that answers a whole square at once.

Nodes.Name: Resupply Drone
Nodes.Description: A construct that keeps the party's orbs topped up.

Nodes.Name: Festering Mark
Nodes.Description: A curse that festers the longer it's left unanswered.

Nodes.Name: Curse of Fate
Nodes.Description: Bind a foe's fate to the damage it's already taken.

Nodes.Name: Blood Harvest
Nodes.Description: Reap what every prior curse has sown.

Nodes.Name: Archmage's Focus
Nodes.Description: Mana discipline that knits a little strength back every turn.

Nodes.Name: Heavy Armor Proficiency
Nodes.Description: Earns the right to wear heavy plate and mail, regardless of class.

Name: Cleric
Description: The Healer archetype: mend and cleanse.

Nodes.Name: Mending Light
Nodes.Description: A wash of light that heals the whole party at once.

Nodes.Name: Sacred Cleanse
Nodes.Description: Purge poison from an ally's blood.

Nodes.Name: Preemptive Ward
Nodes.Description: Ward an ally before the blow ever lands.

Nodes.Name: Cleansing Vigil
Nodes.Description: A standing vigil that cleanses as it watches.

Nodes.Name: Sanctuary Rite
Nodes.Description: A rite that wards the whole party at once - the cleric's own Barrier.

Nodes.Name: Thorned Hex
Nodes.Description: A hex that bites back at whatever it's cast on.

Nodes.Name: Harm Into Hope
Nodes.Description: Turn a foe's own hurt into an ally's healing.

Nodes.Name: Mirrorcurse
Nodes.Description: Reflect a curse back onto the hand that cast it.

Nodes.Name: Guardian's Rush
Nodes.Description: Close the gap to the ally who needs it most.

Nodes.Name: Flowing Current
Nodes.Description: A current of healing that washes over everyone nearby.

Nodes.Name: Covering Withdrawal
Nodes.Description: Cover a wounded ally's retreat.

Nodes.Name: Divine Vigor
Nodes.Description: A standing blessing that knits wounds every turn.

Nodes.Name: Martial Weapons
Nodes.Description: Earns the right to wield any weapon in the armory, regardless of class.

Name: Alchemist
Description: The Support archetype: tempo, tonics and field remedies.

Nodes.Name: Quickening Brew
Nodes.Description: A tonic that hastens an ally's next turn.

Nodes.Name: Binding Toxin
Nodes.Description: A reagent that slows whatever it touches.

Nodes.Name: Shortcut
Nodes.Description: Send an ally the fast way across the board.

Nodes.Name: Stumbling Ground
Nodes.Description: Ground that turns a foe's footing against it.

Nodes.Name: Swift Swap
Nodes.Description: Trade two combatants' places in an eyeblink.

Nodes.Name: Suppression Mine
Nodes.Description: A mine that silences whatever sets it off.

Nodes.Name: Field Patch
Nodes.Description: A field repair kit turned on flesh instead of steel.

Nodes.Name: Overdrive Tap
Nodes.Description: Tap the party's own mana reserve for a burst.

Nodes.Name: Alpha's Challenge
Nodes.Description: Call the pack's attention onto you.

Nodes.Name: Pack Rally
Nodes.Description: Rally the pack behind whoever leads the charge.

Nodes.Name: Den Mother's Guard
Nodes.Description: A guardian's ward, pack-taught rather than priest-taught.

Nodes.Name: Elixir of Vigor
Nodes.Description: A reagent blend potent enough to mend wounds every turn, unasked.

Nodes.Name: Arcane Focus
Nodes.Description: Sharpens a hand not born to the arcane, regardless of class.
